ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is an herbivore in this diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is titled “COASTAL FOOD WEB.” It shows organisms labeled Plankton, Algae, Soft-Shell Clam, Horseshoe Crab and Eggs, Blue Crab, Menhaden, and Striped Bass. Near the bottom center, “Algae” has an arrow pointing upward to “Soft-Shell Clam.” Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate food or energy moving from what is eaten to the eater. An herbivore is an organism that eats plants or algae. Since the Soft-Shell Clam receives energy from Algae, the herbivore in the diagram is the clam.
